notes.title: The Intruders, VR and You
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35855170/8ac1c58bbb2a856ff878d0f193bf5cfdb6c8686e.jpg[/img]

Heyho Everyone,

With its arrival to the Steam Store, Intruders: Hide and Seek adapts itself to the more powerful PC platform which comes with different types of control, as well as upgrades in other aspects. An increase in the refresh rate and graphics will be noticeable with respect to the previous PS4 version. 
For the players who are less used to the VR devices, Intruders will be compatible with the traditional control system, which will allow experiencing this intense thriller with both keyboard and mouse and gamepad. 



Intruders: Hide and Seek will be compatible with 
[list]
[*] Oculus Rift
[*] HTC Vive 
[*] Windows Mixed Reality 
[/list]

It will also support and take advantage of the new movement hardware 3dRudder, a device which will shorten the gap between the real human movement and the digital character movement.

[previewyoutube=PmwgkJuvHdo;full][/previewyoutube]

Eventhough you are free to enjoy Intruders: Hide and Seek without VR-Devices, the full frightening rollercoaster is ideally played in Virtual Reality.
